question: In which year was the third Anglo Mysore war fought?
solution: The correct answer is __**1790-92**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Third Anglo-Mysore War** was fought between the years **1790 and 1792**. It was one of the four Anglo-Mysore wars fought between the British East India Company and the Kingdom of Mysore. • This war was a result of the growing territorial ambitions of both the **British East India Company** and **Tipu Sultan**, the ruler of Mysore. • The war began due to Tipu Sultan's expansionist activities, including his attack on the **Travancore Kingdom**, which was a British ally. • The war ended with the signing of the **Treaty of Seringapatam** in 1792, which marked a significant territorial loss for Mysore. • Tipu Sultan had to cede almost **half of his kingdom** to the British and their allies, including parts of modern-day Tamil Nadu, Kerala, and Karnataka.
